note: 7 candidates selected -- honestly below the task's 'roughly 8-15' target range. Not padded to hit the range: the shortfall is real (see rejected.json for why RouteLLM, gortex, and 3 papers could not be tested this pass), not a lack of effort. See final_report.md for the full funnel.

selected.canonical_procedure: Run parallel coding agents each in its own git worktree so concurrent file/git operations never collide.
selected.headline_number: 1/8 -> 8/8 success rate under real concurrent git operations
selected.adopt_as: Confirms an already-real, already-in-use StealthLab pattern (this session itself ran across 8 worktrees) with hard numbers -- worth citing as evidenced practice, not a new build.

selected.canonical_procedure: Advertise tool names only up front; load a tool's full schema on demand.
selected.adopt_as: Already StealthLab's own deployed mechanism -- this is independent confirmation of its value, not a new adoption.

selected.canonical_procedure: Get a deterministic structural signature outline of a file (tree-sitter) instead of reading it whole, for orientation.
selected.headline_number: 77.0% token reduction, real file, real repo
